description: This file contains reduction functions and utilities for masked tensors in PyTorch, including implementations for masked all, masked any, and reduction operations like sum, mean, argmin, argmax, etc., specifically tailored for sparse and dense tensor layouts.

methods.name: _masked_all_all
methods.description: Performs a masked 'all' operation on data, filling unmasked elements with True if mask is provided.

methods.name: _masked_all_dim
methods.description: Performs a masked 'all' operation along a specified dimension, with optional keepdim.

methods.name: _masked_all
methods.description: Dispatches to either _masked_all_all or _masked_all_dim based on arguments.

methods.name: _multidim_any
methods.description: Performs a logical 'any' operation over multiple dimensions of a mask tensor.

methods.name: _get_masked_fn
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate masked reduction function based on a string identifier.

methods.name: _torch_reduce_all
methods.description: Creates a reduction function for 'all' operation on masked tensors, handling sparse and dense cases.

methods.name: _torch_reduce_dim
methods.description: Creates a reduction function for a specific dimension, with warnings for sparse tensors.

methods.name: _torch_reduce
methods.description: Generates a combined reduction function for either all or specific dimensions.

methods.name: _is_reduction
methods.description: Checks if a function is a registered reduction function.

methods.name: _apply_reduction
methods.description: Applies the appropriate reduction function based on the input function.
